convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicators (Color_PEMA_Envelopes and PEMA_Envelopes_Digit) for signal generation and envelope levels, which require custom .ex5 indicator files not available as built-in MT5 indicators. The trading logic itself is straightforward but depends on custom indicator buffers.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one in reverse direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MMValue=fixed lots (absolute value), Positive MMValue=percentage of deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: EA uses two custom indicators: Color_PEMA_Envelopes (for envelope visualization/trend) and PEMA_Envelopes_Digit_System (for discrete buy/sell signal generation). Signal reversal automatically closes opposite positions. SL/TP values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers (multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001). Money management uses a conditional scheme where the sign of MMValue input determines whether lot size is fixed or a deposit fraction.
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicators Color_PEMA_Envelopes and PEMA_Envelopes_Digit_System must be reimplemented in Python or their buffer values pre-computed and stored as CSV. The PEMA (Parabolic EMA) envelope logic is non-standard and must be ported from the indicator source code. Digit adjustment for SL/TP on 5-digit brokers must be replicated. The conditional money management (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) needs careful handling. New-bar guard logic must be implemented to prevent multiple entries per bar.
